Roll the dice to find out how many spaces you must move forward.
Each space has a specific characteristic, in this case, you stopped at a Blue Coins space.
Good! You got Blue Coins! Use these coins to buy Gold Coins and Power-ups.

The player with the most Gold Coins at the end of the game wins!

Repeat the sequence shown by clicking the correct colors. Miss a color and you'll be out of the game!
Use the tweezers to drag and drop fleas in the correct bucket. The player with the most captured fleas wins the game.
Lock it up! Click on your orange locker to keep them closed, but watch out--the other players are trying to keep them open. The first player to close all their lockers wins!

PRESS LEFT AND RIGHT TO MOVE

It's pizza time! Race through the sewers and use spacebar to jump over obstacles. Be careful not to drop any pizza!
USE ARROWS TO MOVE & UP TO OPEN DOORS
Sam and Cat are having a party, and you're invited! Navigate their maze-like apartment, 'til you get to room 22.
CLICK AND DRAG WITH YOUR MOUSE
Sam & Cat have a goat in their apartment, and it's demanding food! Give it the food it asks for, by clicking and dragging food to the goat.
Protect your flag! Click on the orange colored jellyfish to catch them in a bubble and watch them float away so that they don't steal your flag. Last player who still has their flag wins!
Move the mouse to slide your bar in this triple sided ice hockey game. The puck will change to the color of the player who scored last. The player with the most scored goals wins!
It's raining notes! The player who has collected the most notes by the end of the timer wins!
WHEN YOUR CHARACTER LANDS ON THE BED
Press the spacebar as your character lands on the bouncy bed so they can jump higher. The player who reaches the bell first wins!
Use the arrow keys to move your character around the Frosty Mart and paint as much of the floor as you can! Whoever has painted the floor the most wins the game.
There is only one way to survive the Spinnin’ Spatula…by jumping over it! Stay on your toes, the last player standing wins.
Ew! Princess OOM is looking to lick you! Avoid her treacherous tongue at all costs. Keep an eye on her eyes, it might just keep you alive. The last player standing wins.
D.O.O.M. is trying to destroy the city with explosives! Use your arrow keys to help stay on top of the moving platforms without falling. The last player standing wins!
Do you have what it takes to finish your lollipop first? Press the spacebar as fast as you can to finish first in this Tasty Race!
Try and keep your balance! Avoid flying bananas on this teetering log and if you're the last one standing, you win!
